theme.en: AI demand redraws Asia's chip supply map
theme.zh: AI需求重绘亚洲芯片供应版图

dek.en: Memory financing, accelerator deployments, and new manufacturing sites are becoming expressions of the same AI-capacity race. The constraint is shifting from compute silicon alone to the suppliers, packaging, and storage layers around it.
dek.zh: 存储融资、加速器部署和新建制造基地，正成为同一场AI产能竞赛的不同表现。实际瓶颈已不再只是计算芯片，还延伸到其周边的供应商、封装与存储层。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Alibaba reportedly backs Kimi K3 with 20,000 Nvidia chips
title.zh: 报道称阿里以2万颗Nvidia芯片支持Kimi K3

summary.en: Tech Times reports that Alibaba funded Kimi K3 with an estimated 20,000 Nvidia chips, making access to compute a competitive issue for Chinese foundation-model developers. The report points to pressure on Qwen as well: capital and GPU allocation can shape model competition as directly as algorithmic progress.
summary.zh: Tech Times报道称，阿里巴巴以约2万颗Nvidia芯片支持Kimi K3，使算力获取成为中国基础模型开发商竞争的核心变量。报道也指出这会给Qwen带来压力：资本与GPU配给对模型竞争的影响，可能不亚于算法进展。

title.en: DFSX claims a 14nm SuperNode can double GB200 NVL72 memory bandwidth
title.zh: DFSX称其14nm SuperNode内存带宽可达GB200 NVL72的两倍

summary.en: DFSX says its TY64 SuperNode, built from 14nm DF2000 chips and vertically organized compute-memory towers, can deliver 960 TB/s of memory bandwidth versus 576 TB/s for Nvidia's GB200 NVL72. The claim argues that packaging and memory topology can offset some leading-edge logic advantage, though it still needs independent workload and power validation.
summary.zh: DFSX称，其由14nm DF2000芯片和垂直计算—存储塔构成的TY64 SuperNode可提供960 TB/s内存带宽，而Nvidia GB200 NVL72为576 TB/s。该主张认为封装和存储拓扑可部分弥补先进逻辑制程差距，但仍需独立的工作负载与功耗验证。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: India's 12 chip sites put materials and equipment in focus
title.zh: 印度12个芯片基地将材料与设备推向焦点

summary.en: Tech Times characterizes India's first 12 chip sites as evidence that assembly can be established, while the next policy phase must extend into materials and manufacturing equipment. Packaging and assembly add capacity quickly, but a durable domestic supply chain also needs process inputs and a tool ecosystem.
summary.zh: Tech Times认为，印度首批12个芯片基地证明组装能力可以落地，但下一阶段政策必须延伸至材料和制造设备。封装与组装可较快增加产能，而持久的本土供应链还需要制程材料和设备生态。

title.en: IonQ completes SkyWater acquisition for vertically integrated quantum platform
title.zh: IonQ完成收购SkyWater，构建垂直整合的量子平台

summary.en: IonQ has completed its acquisition of SkyWater Technology, according to Pulse 2.0, pairing a quantum-computing company with a U.S. semiconductor manufacturing operation. The move makes fabrication control part of its platform strategy, although the benefit depends on how closely process development is tied to its quantum-hardware roadmap.
summary.zh: 据Pulse 2.0报道，IonQ已完成对SkyWater Technology的收购，将量子计算公司与美国半导体制造业务结合。这一举措把制造控制纳入平台战略，但实际收益取决于制程开发能否与其量子硬件路线图紧密协同。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: CXMT IPO puts China's memory ambitions under scrutiny
title.zh: CXMT IPO令中国存储雄心接受市场检验

summary.en: Fortune says CXMT's prospective blockbuster IPO will test whether China's memory makers can turn investment and policy support into a durable market position. The issue is not simply capital raised: the company must demonstrate competitive technology, yields, and customer qualification against entrenched DRAM suppliers.
summary.zh: Fortune指出，CXMT备受关注的IPO将检验中国存储厂商能否把投资和政策支持转化为持久的市场地位。关键不只是融资规模，而在于该公司能否在技术、良率和客户认证上与成熟DRAM供应商竞争。

title.en: FMS 2026 spotlights liquid-cooled PCIe 6.0 SSDs and AI memory tiers
title.zh: FMS 2026聚焦液冷PCIe 6.0 SSD与AI存储层级

summary.en: FMS 2026 is set to open with liquid-cooled PCIe 6.0 SSDs and a debate over how AI systems should divide data across memory tiers, Tech Times reports. The pairing reflects a systems problem: bandwidth, cooling, and data placement must be engineered together rather than treated as separate storage upgrades.
summary.zh: Tech Times报道，FMS 2026将以液冷PCIe 6.0 SSD和AI系统如何划分存储层级的讨论开幕。这一组合反映出系统问题：带宽、散热和数据放置必须协同设计，而不能视为彼此独立的存储升级。

title.en: AI boom tests South Korean semiconductor suppliers
title.zh: AI热潮考验韩国半导体供应商

summary.en: Donga.com examines how the AI boom is testing South Korea's semiconductor suppliers, a group central to the global memory and component chain. Suppliers must convert AI orders into sustained capacity, qualified materials, and reliable delivery while avoiding overbuilding for a short cycle.
summary.zh: donga.com探讨AI热潮如何考验韩国半导体供应商，这一群体处于全球存储和元件供应链的核心。供应商必须把AI订单转化为可持续产能、合格材料和可靠交付，同时避免为短周期过度扩产。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 新兴挑战者

title.en: Lattrex pitches an asynchronous reconfigurable processor
title.zh: Lattrex主推异步可重构处理器

summary.en: Lattrex founder Chuck McClish outlines Kyttar, a clockless reconfigurable processor aimed at real-time signal processing, in a SemiWiki interview. The startup is positioning asynchronous design as a route to a differentiated compute architecture; translating the concept into software tools, volume silicon, and customers will determine its relevance.
summary.zh: Lattrex创始人Chuck McClish在SemiWiki访谈中介绍Kyttar，这是一款面向实时信号处理的无时钟可重构处理器。该初创公司将异步设计定位为差异化计算架构的路径；其意义最终取决于软件工具、量产芯片和客户的落地。

theme.zh: 硬件感知设计直面数据移动瓶颈

dek.en: This week's selection shifts attention from nominal operations to the interfaces that make them useful: unstable clocks, KV-cache noise, chiplet PHYs, and HLS verification. Several papers offer measured or simulated gains, but their practical value hinges on device variation and system-level integration.
dek.zh: 本周论文把关注点从名义运算能力转向决定其实用性的接口：不稳定时钟、KV缓存噪声、chiplet PHY以及HLS验证。多篇工作给出测量或仿真增益，但其实际价值仍取决于器件变异和系统级集成。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: Low-Power PLL-Based Clock Stabilization for Flexible IGZO Mixed-Signal Systems
title.zh: 面向柔性IGZO混合信号系统的低功耗PLL时钟稳定技术

papers.authors: Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte, Georgios Zervakis, Mehdi Tahoori

summary.en: The authors propose a PLL tailored to n-type-only amorphous IGZO thin-film transistors, using low-bandwidth feedback to stabilize a ring-oscillator clock under large process, voltage, and temperature variation. It targets flexible mixed-signal electronics, where conventional clock sources can consume up to 90% of system power. This is a temporal stabilizer rather than a precision synthesizer, so its value depends on tolerance for residual jitter and drift.
summary.zh: 作者提出面向仅含n型非晶IGZO薄膜晶体管的PLL，以低带宽反馈在较大的工艺、电压和温度变化下稳定环形振荡器时钟。其目标是柔性混合信号电子系统，传统时钟源在此类系统中可消耗高达90%的系统功耗。这更像时间稳定器而非高精度频率合成器，因此价值取决于应用对残余抖动和漂移的容忍度。

title.en: EDA & Design Automation
title.zh: EDA与设计自动化

title.en: RTLCurator: Label-Efficient Data Curation for RTL Generation
title.zh: RTLCurator：面向RTL生成的高标签效率数据筛选

papers.authors: Siyang Cai, Cangyuan Li, Wenjing Chang, et al.

summary.en: RTLCurator learns a behavior-aware compatibility prior from a small set of validated examples to select training data for RTL-generating models. Only 24.4% and 53.5% of pairs in two common synthetic RTL datasets pass generated functional tests, the paper says. By balancing alignment, diversity, and complexity, it seeks to retain data beyond simple correct modules, but remains dependent on representative validation labels.
summary.zh: RTLCurator从少量已验证样本中学习行为感知的兼容性先验，用于筛选RTL生成模型的训练数据。论文指出，两个常用合成RTL数据集分别仅有24.4%和53.5%的样本对能通过自动生成的功能测试。该方法平衡对齐度、多样性和复杂度，试图保留超越简单正确模块的数据，但仍依赖具有代表性的验证标签。

title.en: ContractHIL-HLS: Contract-Aligned Hardware-in-the-Loop Workflow for HLS
title.zh: ContractHIL-HLS：契约对齐、硬件在环的HLS工作流

papers.authors: Jingbo Zhang, Haoxiang Sun, Wenbo Wang, Wenbo Zhang

summary.en: ContractHIL-HLS turns natural-language design requests into explicit interfaces, constraints, checks, and rollback rules, then feeds HLS, Vivado, PYNQ, power, and failure evidence back into generation. On 94 HLS-Eval tasks, its structured contract lifted estimated single-sample testbench pass rate from 64.0% to 70.2%. The feedback loop makes LLM-assisted HLS more verifiable, though board-level closure remains harder than benchmark tasks.
summary.zh: ContractHIL-HLS将自然语言设计需求转化为明确的接口、约束、检查和回滚规则，再把HLS、Vivado、PYNQ、功耗与失败证据反馈到生成过程。在94个HLS-Eval任务上，结构化契约将估计的单样本测试平台通过率从64.0%提高至70.2%。该反馈循环使LLM辅助HLS更可验证，但板级收敛仍比基准任务更难。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: Selective KV-Cache Protection for Analog Compute-in-Memory LLM Inference
title.zh: 用于模拟存算一体LLM推理的选择性KV缓存保护

papers.authors: Yuannuo Feng, Wenyong Zhou, Yuang Ma, et al.

summary.en: The paper identifies initial and recent tokens as especially vulnerable to analog noise when KV-cache updates run on compute-in-memory arrays. Its scheme keeps those tokens on a higher-precision digital path while sending most cache data through analog hardware. Across nine LLMs, average perplexity falls from 33.91 to 11.95 under analog noise, but the trade-off depends on programming overhead and the noise model.
summary.zh: 论文发现，当KV缓存更新在存算一体阵列上运行时，初始token和最近token对模拟噪声尤其敏感。其方案将这些token保留在高精度数字路径，同时把大部分缓存数据交由模拟硬件处理。作者在9个LLM上报告，模拟噪声下平均困惑度从33.91降至11.95，但权衡取决于编程开销和噪声模型。

title.en: Heterogeneous Accelerator for Multitask RF Signal Recognition
title.zh: 面向多任务射频信号识别的异构加速器

papers.authors: Zhifan Song, Haralampos-G. Stratigopoulos, Hassan Aboushady

summary.en: This accelerator combines an attention-enhanced CNN, learnable streaming decimation, fused convolution-pooling, DMA streaming, and CPU co-execution for RF tasks. It reports 98 microseconds per frame, at least 99% average modulation-recognition accuracy above 4 dB SNR, and 99.5% for GNSS-jamming classification. Dataset accuracy is encouraging, but does not fully characterize field robustness.
summary.zh: 该加速器将带注意力的CNN、可学习流式抽取、融合卷积—池化、DMA流和CPU协同执行用于射频任务。作者报告每帧98微秒延迟，在4 dB以上SNR的调制识别中平均准确率至少99%，GNSS干扰分类为99.5%。数据集准确率令人鼓舞，但尚不能完全说明现场鲁棒性。

title.en: Circuits & Architecture
title.zh: 电路与体系结构

title.en: DICE: End-to-End PHY Modeling for Chiplet Simulation
title.zh: DICE：用于chiplet仿真的端到端PHY建模

papers.authors: Rashid Aligholipour, Stefanos Kaxiras, Yuan Yao

summary.en: DICE adds runtime-dependent PHY behavior to chiplet simulation, accounting for channel noise, crosstalk, jitter, iterative FEC decoding, retransmissions, and application traffic. The authors argue that fixed-latency links distort packet behavior as short-reach interconnects approach signal-integrity limits. The detail can improve architectural decisions, but credible early-stage device and channel parameters are needed.
summary.zh: DICE将运行时相关的PHY行为引入chiplet仿真，纳入信道噪声、串扰、抖动、迭代FEC解码、重传和应用流量。作者认为，当短距互连接近信号完整性极限时，固定延迟链路会扭曲数据包行为。细节建模可改善架构决策，但需要可信的早期器件和信道参数。
